back2basics.text: The creamy layer concept excludes economically advanced individuals within the Other Backward Classes (OBC) from reservation benefits to ensure affirmative action reaches the genuinely disadvantaged. The policy uses income and wealth criteria to identify the non-creamy layer eligible for reservations in education and government jobs. Judicial interpretations clarify how these criteria are applied and whether decisions affect past recruitments or only future cases.

2026-11-06-pm-470e7489bd.deck: The Supreme Court clarified on November 6, 2026, that its March 11 judgment on the OBC creamy layer policy does not require revising past service allocations or seniority. This clarification is crucial for understanding the limits of judicial intervention in reservation policies and their implementation.

editor.prelimsAngle: OBC creamy layer policy and Supreme Court ruling.

mcq.stem:
Consider the following statements about the Supreme Court's March 2026 judgment on the OBC creamy layer policy:

body.label: Limited to parties involved

body.label: Pending service allocation

back2basics.text: Midterm elections in the United States occur every four years, halfway through a president's term, to elect members of Congress including all House representatives and one-third of the Senate. back2basics.concept: Air Quality Index (AQI) and Pollution Levels
back2basics.text: The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a numerical scale used to communicate how polluted the air currently is or how polluted it is forecast to become. It ranges from 'good' to 'severe' levels, with higher values indicating worse air quality. 'Severe' pollution means the air is harmful even to healthy individuals and poses serious health risks to vulnerable groups. Factors like weather conditions, emissions from vehicles, industries, and seasonal activities like crop burning affect AQI.

2026-11-06-pm-9e73e33444.deck: Delhi's air quality worsened to a 'severe' level on November 6, 2026, affecting many parts of the city and nearby regions. This is important for UPSC aspirants to understand urban pollution dynamics, health impacts, and government monitoring systems.

back2basics.text: Monetary policy tools are instruments used by central banks like RBI to regulate money supply and interest rates in the economy. Reverse repo operations involve the central bank borrowing money from commercial banks, thus absorbing liquidity. Variable rate auctions allow the interest rate to be determined by market demand, helping RBI manage short-term liquidity efficiently.

2026-11-06-pm-ab3fe53f80.deck: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) conducted variable rate reverse repo (VRRR) auctions on November 4 and 5, 2026, absorbing liquidity from the banking system. body.label: Definition of VRRR
body.text: Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auctions are monetary policy operations where RBI absorbs excess liquidity from banks by borrowing funds at variable interest rates.

body.label: Purpose of VRRR
body.text: RBI conducts VRRR auctions to manage surplus liquidity in the banking system, thereby helping to maintain short-term interest rates within the policy corridor.

body.label: Effect on money market rates
